sections.heading: Braze limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Custom pricing only — opaque without a sales process; Overkill for SMB newsletter/ESP-only jobs; Requires customer data maturity and ops investment because it forces process changes or add-ons around Braze when funnel builder is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Go with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain content calendar at the expense of Specialist depth (listening vs scheduling vs funnels) vs all-in-one breadth — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Go · content calendar | Select | Pro.

Alternative context: unlike Adobe Marketo Engage, Braze is preferable when Enterprise B2C brands orchestrating multi-channel engagement because funnel builder plus content calendar match; prefer Adobe Marketo Engage when SMBs wanting published freemium ESP pricing because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Braze
sections.body:
